story.text: At one o’clock the first spirit comes: the Ghost of Christmas Past, like a {CHILD} and an old man at once, with a bright clear {JET} of light springing from its {HEAD}. It takes Scrooge to his old school, where a {LONELY} boy sits reading by a {FEEBLE} fire. Then in runs his little sister, Fan: “I have come to bring you {HOME}, dear brother!” The {SCHOOLMASTER} brings out curiously light {WINE} and curiously heavy {CAKE}.
story.caption: He produced a decanter of curiously light wine, and a block of curiously heavy cake
